checker_failure: y more than 6 mV from the checker's RK4 state solution on the saved u at any saved row, or a complex response error y/u above 0.03*max(1,|H|) at 500 Hz, 2 kHz, 8 kHz or 16 kHz over t >= stop/2 (tests/v2_next_filter.py:55-66)
semantics: ctle-0 uses the default parameters with zero initial states; ctle-1 overrides every parameter and both initial states. A candidate that ignores overrides or initial states is indistinguishable from the reference on ctle-0 and on the public case, which is identical to ctle-0. ctle-endpoints (first30-fix-r4) takes legal-domain endpoints fz = fp1 = 2000 Hz, fp2 = 24000 Hz, gain 0.5, x1init 0.1 and x2init -0.1, written in the instance line exactly as the instruction writes the range ends (the reference declares no `from` range). With fz = fp1 the zero cancels the first pole in H(s), while x1 still relaxes at fp1 from x1init, so the time response is not a one-pole filter; zero_normalized_to_first_pole gives y = gain*x1 there. Legacy EVAS cannot run sine sources, so the ctle-endpoints expectations come from analytic synthetic responses only and wait for Spectre.
